title: Revelle College General Education
source_note: Revelle 学院官网 GE 页（2026-10-28 核对）；转学规则见学院 Fall 2026 转学要求页。

sections.title: Humanities

requirements.name: Humanities sequence
requirements.note: Five-course sequence HUM 1 (winter) -> HUM 2 (spring) -> HUM 3 (fall/summer) -> HUM 4 (winter/summer) -> HUM 5 (spring/summer). Letter grade.
requirements.note_zh: 人文 5 门序列：HUM 1（冬）→ HUM 2（春）→ HUM 3（秋/夏）→ HUM 4（冬/夏）→ HUM 5（春/夏），须 letter grade。

sections.note: Five-course humanities sequence, letter grade required.
sections.note_zh: 人文序列 5 门，须 letter grade。

sections.title: Mathematics

requirements.name: Mathematics
requirements.note: 1 quarter of calculus (MATH 10A/20A) plus 2 courses from MATH 10B/20B, 10C/20C, 11, 18/31AH, DSC 10, PHIL 10, PSYC 60. Letter grade.
requirements.note_zh: 微积分 1 门（MATH 10A/20A）+ 再 2 门（MATH 10B/20B、10C/20C、11、18/31AH、DSC 10、PHIL 10、PSYC 60），须 letter grade。

sections.note: 1 calculus course + 2 more, letter grade required.
sections.note_zh: 微积分 1 门 + 再 2 门，须 letter grade。

sections.title: Natural Science

requirements.name: Natural Science
requirements.note: 5 courses: 1 Biology + 1 Chemistry + 1 Physics + 2 additional from the approved list. Labs are not required for GE (major may require them). Science/engineering/math majors advised letter grade; arts/humanities/social science majors may take P/NP.
requirements.note_zh: 自然科学 5 门：生物 1 门 + 化学 1 门 + 物理 1 门 + 另 2 门（批准清单内）。GE 不要求实验课（专业可能要求）。理工科专业建议 letter grade，文社科专业可 P/NP。

sections.note_zh: 5 门：生物、化学、物理各 1 门 + 另 2 门。

sections.title: Social Science

requirements.name: Social Science
requirements.note: 2 courses (4 units each, upper or lower division) from approved social science departments. Letter grade. Department restrictions: AAS 10/11/14/15 only; COMM 10/20/30/80 only; COGS only the listed courses; Economics lower division only; ENG 30 only; GSS 20/22/27 only; LATI 10/50 only; Linguistics excluding language courses; PHIL 51/148 only; POLI 10-179; HILD 7A/7B/7C only. Other approved departments (any course unless restricted): Anthropology, Critical Gender Studies, Education Studies, Ethnic Studies, Human Developmental Science, International Studies, Psychology, Sociology, Urban Studies and Planning. Special Studies courses do not count; upper-division major courses may not overlap GE. Remote (R) versions accepted.
requirements.note_zh: 社会科学 2 门（每门 4 学分，高/低年级均可），须 letter grade。批准系所 + 限课：AAS 仅 10/11/14/15；COMM 仅 10/20/30/80；COGS 仅下表课程；经济仅低年级；ENG 仅 30；GSS 仅 20/22/27；LATI 仅 10/50；语言学不含语言课；PHIL 仅 51/148；POLI 10–179；HILD 仅 7A/7B/7C。其余批准系（人类学、批判性别研究、教育研究、族裔研究、人类发展科学、国际研究、心理、社会学、城市研究与规划）不限课程。Special Studies 不计；高年级专业课不得与 GE 重叠；R 远程版亦可。

sections.note: 2 courses, letter grade; department restrictions in the requirement note.
sections.note_zh: 2 门，须 letter grade；系所限课见要求备注。

requirements.name: Fine Arts
requirements.note: 1 course (2-4 units) from Music, Theatre, Dance, or Visual Arts. May be P/NP unless the major requires a letter grade.
requirements.note_zh: 美术 1 门（2–4 学分），音乐/戏剧/舞蹈/视觉艺术中选；除非专业要求 letter grade，否则可 P/NP。

sections.title: Language

requirements.name: Language proficiency
requirements.note: Proficiency in a language other than English, demonstrated by exam or completion of a fourth-quarter intermediate course (0-4 courses depending on placement). May be P/NP unless the major requires a letter grade.
requirements.note_zh: 非英语外语达标：考试通过，或修到第四学期中级水平（按 placement 从 0 到 4 门不等）；除非专业要求 letter grade，否则可 P/NP。

sections.note: Proficiency by exam or fourth-quarter level, 0-4 courses.
sections.note_zh: 达标制：考试或第四学期水平，0–4 门不等。

sections.title: Transfer Students

requirements.name: HUM 100 for transfers
requirements.note: All transfer students admitted Fall 2024 and later must take HUM 100 within their first year. Students with IGETC/Cal-GETC: HUM 1-5 waived, but full Mathematics and Natural Science requirements still required. UC Reciprocity satisfies lower-division GE; required upper-division GE is HUM 100. Transfer students admitted Fall 2026 and after: Natural Science is 3 courses (2 from different Biology/Chemistry/Physics disciplines + 1 additional).
requirements.note_zh: 2024 秋及以后入学的转学生须在第一年内修 HUM 100。IGETC/Cal-GETC 免 HUM 1–5，但数学与自然科学须全修；UC Reciprocity 满足低年级 GE，高年级 GE 为 HUM 100。2026 秋及以后入学的转学生自然科学为 3 门（生物/化学/物理中两个不同学科 2 门 + 另 1 门）。

sections.note: Transfers: HUM 100 + full Math/Natural Science (IGETC included).
sections.note_zh: 转学生：HUM 100 + 数学/自然科学全修（IGETC 亦同）。
